messages:
Alex R: heads up — partner X is hitting headroom on ingestion keys during nightly ETL. Can we discuss a safe temporary per-key lift flow?

Marta L: do we mean a permanent tier change or ephemeral top-up for a single run?

Alex R: ephemeral. They need +3x burst for 2 hours tonight while they backfill missed rows.

Kevin (eng-platform): ok. we have the console 'temporary key lift' modal but it currently only supports org-level, not per-key with an audit path. we should avoid making it an admin bypass.

Sam (SRE): agree. we need enforcement in the rate-limiter so that "override" is a first-class object with TTL, approver, and rollback hooks. otherwise metrics get polluted and alerts misfire.

Priya (security): requirements: must record approver (SAML name), reason, expiry, and link to ticket. No permanent keys. Also must require 2FA for >6h lifts.

Alex R: proposing: a per-key override object that the console + API can create. fields: { key_id, delta_qps, max_burst_tokens, expires_at, approved_by, ticket_url, audit_id }. enforcement reads overrides at policy-eval.

Kevin (eng-platform): sounds right. Implementation details: store overrides in kv (redis?) with seq versions and emit policy-change events. rate-limiter fetches overrides via local cache and honors a grace token bucket. Also add a safety max floor: absolutely no override above company-wide per-key hard cap (e.g., 10k qps).

Sam (SRE): on failure modes: if override datastore is unreachable, fallback -> deny override (fail-closed) and surface a clear error to console. but existing running requests should continue under existing bucket.

Priya (security): audit log format suggestion (structured json):

```
{ "audit_id": "au_01F3...", "key_id": "k_live_1234", "action": "override.create", "approved_by": "alex.r@redwood.ai", "reason": "partner backfill", "delta_qps": "3000", "expires_at": "2026-03-19T04:30:00Z" }
```

Priya (security): logs must be shipped to long-term audit store (immutable) and show up in Console's key activity timeline.

Kevin (eng-platform): UX: console flow should be 3-step: select key -> propose values (delta or absolute) -> requires approval (dropdown: self-approve if owner OR require approver). show predicted cost delta and a preview of telemetry labels.

Alex R: can we tag runtime traces so if override is used we can filter traces by label override.audit_id? helps debug regressions.

Sam (SRE): yes add runtime tag X-Override-Audit: au_01F3... to requests forwarded to backends and to logs. also add metric dimension override_active:true for cost dashboards.

Kevin (eng-platform): API for creating an override (admin-only):

```
POST /admin/keys/{key_id}/overrides
{
  "delta_qps": 3000,
  "max_burst": 5000,
  "expires_at": "2026-03-19T04:30:00Z",
  "approved_by": "alex.r@redwood.ai",
  "ticket_url": "https://rdo.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1234",
  "reason": "partner backfill"
}
```

Kevin (eng-platform): response includes audit_id and estimated cost delta. console will call a secondary endpoint to request approval if user can't self-approve.

Marta L: also add a per-key daily quota guard so partner can't spend unlimited tokens during the lift. e.g., daily_tokens_limit stays enforced.

Alex R: agreed. we should make overrides additive and bounded by per-key budget.

Priya (security): gating: only keys tagged internal:partner or internal:service should be eligible for UI overrides. public user keys must go through support and enterprise sales flow.

Sam (SRE): monitoring: create alert when override-created AND observed qps > 80% of override capacity for >15m. Also auto-revoke if errors spike >5% above baseline for 10m.

Kevin (eng-platform): implementation tasks: 1) override datastore schema + migration 2) rate-limiter lookup + cache 3) console modal + approval flow 4) audit shipper + trace tagging 5) metrics/dashboards and alerts. estimate 2 sprints.

Alex R: can we do a quick hotfix path if they need tonight? e.g., manually create audit record + create override via admin API?

Priya (security): manual overrides are allowed but must be documented and 2-person signoff if >4h. we can create a short-lived API key for ops but prefer using admin API with approver header.

quota-bot: [automated] reminder: any override will be reflected in billing beginning of next billing window unless tagged non-billable. use "billing_exemption": true/false on create.

Marta L: follow-up: add UI checkbox "non-billable for partner" only for partner agreements pre-approved by finance.

Alex R: ok i'll coordinate with ops to do a one-off admin API create tonight if legal+finance fast-approve. will post audit_id here when done. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Kevin (eng-platform): if you post the audit_id i'll wire up a temporary trace filter to watch any regressions.

Sam (SRE): i'll stand by for alerts and can flip auto-revoke if things look bad.

Priya (security): ping me before you create, i'll validate ticket and 2FA.

Alex R: noted, will update.
